title: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child lists drugs abused by young people (alcohol, tobacco, bhang, glue, miraa), says why young people start (pressure, curiosity, stress), outlines effects (health, school, family, crime), names values to stay free (self-control, obedience, responsibility, courage) and says no.

floor.question: What is self-control?
floor.answer: Choosing what is right instead of what a feeling pushes

representations: a chart: drug, why people start, effect

board.do: Draw a chart with three columns: drug, why, effect.

board.say: What does drug abuse do to a learner?

board.do: Wait for the child to name an effect.
Write the values that help say no.

listen_for: Taking medicine as the doctor says
misconceptions.repair: Ask the difference between medicine given by a nurse and a pill taken for fun.

misconceptions.ask: Who can be tempted to use drugs?
misconceptions.repair: Ask about older pupils who offer cigarettes.

listen_for: One try can never harm you
misconceptions.ask: What is true about trying a harmful drug just once?
misconceptions.repair: Say that many people started with one try.

misconceptions.ask: What is an effect of alcohol and drug abuse?

checks.question: Is taking medicine as the doctor says drug abuse?
Name one effect of drug abuse.
